info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Carrental Reservations Returns-v3-spec
info.description: The Carrental Reservations Returns API provides a streamlined way to access information about rental car return reservations. It allows users to retrieve the details of returns submitted by customers, facilitating better management of rental operations and customer interactions. This API is particularly beneficial for rental agencies and fleet managers who need to monitor and report on vehicle returns. Typical use cases include auditing returns, tracking vehicle availability, and managing customer inquiries regarding their reservations.

get.summary: Retrieve details of a returned reservation
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the details associated with a reservation that has been returned. Use this information for tracking returned items and updating inventory.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to return a reservation. It must contain the necessary information for processing the return and should conform to the defined schema.

200.description: The request was processed successfully, and the reservation details are returned.

referenceNumber.description: A unique identifier for the reservation.

resultId.description: The ID of the result from the operation.

state.description: The current state of the reservation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: Any additional message regarding the operation.
